title: GPU and chip hardware stories vs neural biology stories on points
question: Does a story about GPU and chip hardware get more points than a story about neural biology?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about GPU and chip hardware gets more points than a story about neural biology.
expect: If true, points per story for GPU and chip hardware stories should be at least 1.5x the value for neural biology stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, GPU and chip hardware against neural biology

group_a.label: GPU and chip hardware stories ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h322 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h322 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
